trust_detail: Evaluator verified by golden tests and 5-way cross-check. No trusted retrieval score: the current code has not been run on the real dataset under the frozen protocol.

retrieval_config.bm25: rank_bm25 BM25Okapi k1=1.6 b=0.75, positive IDF, camel/snake splitting, English+code stopwords, title field weight 2.0 (title = doc id on Apps)
retrieval_config.dense: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384-d, normalized, dot product, threshold 0.05, max 256 word-pieces
retrieval_config.official_representation: one vector per document (benchmark/run_mteb.py); windows only in the direct adapter via apps_fixed.npy
retrieval_config.hybrid: RRF k=60, lexical_weight=1.0, semantic_weight=1.0, union of both lists
retrieval_config.reranker: NONE — CROSS_ENCODER_AVAILABLE hardcoded False; 'reranked' aliases hybrid; disabled code uses invalid model id 'mxbai-rerank-base-v2' and swallows errors
retrieval_config.tie_break: ASTFLOW: doc id ascending; MTEB/trec_eval re-sort ties by doc id descending
retrieval_config.depth_note: Benchmark ranks with limit=1000 so size=max(500,1000)=1000 per list; the product app uses 500 and enables boosts

evaluator_results.mteb: NOT RUN on current code (dataset unavailable); its scorer is pytrec_eval, verified above
evaluator_results.scope: synthetic golden + randomized cases only; not yet on the real run

bottleneck_detail: No trusted run of the current code exists yet. Older official runs hint at candidate retrieval (Recall@100 ~0.30) but are not current.

oracle_identity: One relevant document per query: Oracle@k NDCG@10 == Hit@k, and NDCG@10 <= Hit@10 (0.20 needs >= 753 of 3,765 queries with the answer in the top 10)

experiments_preregistered.entry: verdict RANKING, or Hybrid Oracle@100 >= 0.20 with actual < half of it
